body:
# SEASON HAS ENDED, SEASON 5 WILL BE UP SOON

AuroraSMP is a Hermitcraft style Minecraft server, we are a tight-knit community with only ~50 discord members and have been running since April 2025

We alternate between vanilla and modded seasons, every _even-numbered_ season will be vanilla, and every _odd-numbered_ season will be modded. Inbetween our main seasons, we have mini seasons which last shorter and have a major gimmick, gimmicks include things like anarchy and skyblock. We're currently on our fourth season, which is vanilla.

This video is a showcase of our last major season, season 3.
<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/6tcxbhqEbEo" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe>

The main gimmick of this season is the Taski company, if you go to their headquarters you can roll a task (like a prank, social challenge or something else) that you can do for 1-3 taski tokens.

In this season we've added ModelApplier, which is a datapack that allows you to add custom models for your items (for hats, armour, decoration and more).

> Why should I join?
- We don't allow griefing, stealing or anything like that
- We have lots of shenanigans, we have alot of pranks and funny moments
- We are currently looking for new members

**We are a whitelist-only SMP, you need to apply in our Discord server to be whitelisted:**
https://discord.gg/5P9KBc3F7z
